_doc: Dataset for the generator's copy (docs/plan-observabilidad-langfuse.md §6-§7). Three FICTIONAL brands (no tenant's data) and 24 briefs spread across kinds, formats, objectives and content types. Constraints are chosen to tempt the model: a 'must_avoid' word the topic invites, a price that must appear, banned words a lazy copy would use. There is no gold copy: the evaluators are the deterministic gates of §6.2 (brand rules, schema, printed lengths, constraints, diversity). Review and extend freely; ids are stable so Langfuse upserts instead of duplicating.
